story.title: Company profile
paragraphs: CRDO is a limited liability company (SARL) based in El Oued province, Algeria, operating in consulting, research, development and innovation.

The company was established with the support of Université Echahid Hamma Lakhdar – El Oued, to connect academic expertise with the needs of economic organizations and public administrations, and to turn research results into actionable solutions.
We rely on a rigorous methodology and a quality management system aligned with ISO 9001:2015, with a commitment to transparency and integrity at every stage of each project.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.text: To be the reference partner in consulting, research and innovation at national and regional level, and to contribute to building a knowledge economy.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To deliver high-quality consulting, research and analytical services, valorize university expertise, and transfer technology to support the competitiveness of organizations.

objectives.title: Our objectives
items: Develop effective partnerships between the university and the economic sector
